Hi Nicholas,

You pay nothing. The return label is prepaid by us, so the shipping back is on our side.

It went out with our email of October 14, the one about the NerdQX fault, with the label attached. If it is not in your inbox, check your junk folder and look for anything from (email hidden) or (email hidden), and it is worth adding both to your contacts so the shipping updates reach you. Just print it, tape it on the box and drop it off, with Shop···· written clearly on the outside.

If you cannot find that email, reply here and I will get the label back to you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Nicholas,

Not a pest at all, and sorry it has not reached you. Your label is already bought and paid for by us, so you owe nothing for the shipping back. Here it is again:

····

It is USPS Ground Advantage, tracking ····. Print it, tape it on the box and hand it in at any USPS counter or drop box. Please write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box so the warehouse matches it up when it lands.

Nothing else changes. Once the NerdQX reaches us and the $79.01 invoice is settled, your Thor P2 goes out and the tracking comes to this address.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

So I'm returning the miner and the psu. I can't remember i originally ordered the meanwell upgrade with one or not. Can u tell me if I did and if so do I need to return that too, the meanwell?

Sent from my T-Mobile 4G LTE Device
Get Outlook for Android<https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg>

Hi Nicholas,

I checked your orders. The NerdQX order from June was the miner on its own, there was no Meanwell upgrade added to it, and I do not see a Meanwell on any of your other orders with us. So no, you do not need to send one back.

Just the NerdQX and the power supply that came in its box. If you have a Meanwell you bought elsewhere and are using with it, keep it, it is yours.

Same as before, Shop···· on the outside of the box with the prepaid USPS label, and the Thor P2 goes out once the QX lands with us and the $79.01 invoice is settled.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
